newsitem.title: UGANDA: Refuge sought for 3,000 Ugandans fleeing rebel invasion.
newsitem.headline: Refuge sought for 3,000 Ugandans fleeing rebel invasion.

text.p: Ugandan officials want 3,000 people fleeing a rebel invasion in western Uganda to move to a camp formerly used for Rwandan refugees, the government-owned Sunday Vision reported.
But the refugees have refused, saying this would be "dehumanising", the report added.
The former refugee camp at Kabunga, southwest Uganda, was left vacant when thousands of Rwandans, housed there after fleeing Rwanda in 1994, returned to their homeland last year.

Ugandan officials are trying to convince the displaced people -- who fled from the Bundibugyo area, close to the border with the Democratic Republic of Congo (formerly Zaire), earlier this month when armed Ugandan rebels stormed the small town -- to move to Kabunga.
